title: Construction of novel Mn0.5Cd0.5S/BiOCl S-scheme heterojunction for ciprofloxacin degradation: mechanism and mineralization

The persistence of fluoroquinolone antibiotics such as ciprofloxacin (CIP) in aquatic environments poses serious environmental and public health risks due to their recalcitrance to conventional wastewater treatment processes.
